visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Four performers are positioned on a stage against a thick, pleated red velvet curtain. From left to right, a young man in a black button-down shirt, a man in a black blazer, a woman in a sleeveless white dress, and an older man in a dark blue shirt are all holding wind instruments—three trumpets and one flute—to their mouths. They all move their fingers and bodies energetically as if performing a very fast piece of music. Numbers 1, 2, 3, and 4 are superimposed above their heads in a simple white font. (2) The music stops suddenly, and all four performers lower their instruments from their faces. A large white question mark appears above the woman in the white dress. She smiles broadly at the camera and uses her right hand to point at herself while holding her flute in her left hand. The three men beside her also break character, smiling or looking towards her, indicating she is the actual performer of the music heard.
